environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB target group forwards HTTP traffic on port 8080 directly to the Flask application. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB and port 8080 from ALB SG to instance. No additional middleware or request filtering is configured. The ALB listener has a default action forwarding to the target group with no additional rules.
